_comment: Cryptic clue bank and ledger (Lab, built 12 Nov 2026; brief: project doc claude/brief-cryptic.md, type spec claude/23_typespec_cryptic.md). Every clue is original, written for the Noodle (no reused published clues). Spans are word indices [from, to) into the clue split on spaces, punctuation ignored. def: the definition, at one end. ind: the signpost (indicator), null for charades and double definitions. fod: the fodder words used as written (anagram, hidden word, reversal, deletion, first letters, alternate letters). parts: the pieces and what each gives (charade: in order; container: outer then inner; sound-alike: the word it sounds like; double definition: the second definition). parse: the formal working. explain: two lines for the finish sheet (signpost, wordplay). checked: the cold solve by an independent checker that saw only the clue and enumeration. Batch 2 (15 Nov 2026, the rest of year one) was written as toolchain/cryptic-batches/2026-11-15-year-one.txt and added by tools/cryptic-import.js, which writes parse and explain from the marks; cut (deletion): head, tail or middle. tools/build-cryptic-batch.js --check re-gates every entry and every page.
